text: Test 2 decides the chain. PSR J1913 plus 1102 has measured masses of 1.599 plus or minus 0.008 and 1.290 plus or minus 0.008 times the sun's mass. Relative to the heavier star, they differ by 19.3% plus or minus 0.7%. The source's limit was 4%. The observed difference is nearly 5 times that threshold. Its 95.4% interval remains above 4% by a wide margin. The asymmetry was published in 2020 and sharpened in 2026.
